source_text: Figure released its latest neural network model Helix 2.5, enabling robots to autonomously handle household chores.
Unitree Robotics is developing a 'self-evolving physical AI' system.
Unitree released the next-generation general humanoid robot foundation model UnifoLM-WLA-1.0 and announced open-sourcing.
Chinese smartphone maker Honor will launch a humanoid robot at Mobile World Congress 2026.
UBTECH has deployed the 'BrainNet 2.0 + Co-Agent' AI dual-loop system for multi-robot collaborative training.
Humanoid robotics is undergoing a paradigm shift, moving from performance-driven showpieces toward practical industrial applications.
